description: Guided opt-out fer LexisNexis. A sailor follows the steps on the checklist; OpenOptOut hands over a one-time email address an' clicks any confirmation link.
instructions: Open https://consumer.risk.lexisnexis.com/opt an' follow the site's steps fer {full_name}. The site asks fer a Social Security or driver's license number, which OpenOptOut never fills in; only finish it if ye be comfortable sharing that with them. Use {contact_email} if it asks fer an email address. Then smash "I've done this".
